questions.question: / Differentiate Consideration for Annuity and Premium for Life Policy.
questions.solution_html:
• Consideration for Annuity is a lump-sum (one-time) payment to secure a regular future
  • income. Life Insurance Premium is a periodic (recurring) payment to secure a death or
  • maturity benefit.

questions.question: Descibe the calculation of claims to be debited to revenue account. / From the following information, calculate the amount of premium to be credited to Revenue Account.
questions.solution_html:
• Claim refers to the amount payable by the insurance company to the policyholders who
  • have suffered losses on account of an insured event. In life insurance claims arise on account
  • of death of the policy holder or maturity of policy. The following points are followed in
  • calculating claims as per Schedule 4 (Benefits Paid) in the revenue account: 1) Closing
  • outstanding claim is added and opening outstanding claim is deducted from claim.2) Claim
  • on reinsurance ceded is deducted and claim on reinsurance accepted is added in Schedule 4
questions.final_answer: on reinsurance ceded is deducted and claim on reinsurance accepted is added in Schedule 4
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: From the following information obtained from the books of Travancore Bank Ltd and MSC Bank Ltd for the year ended 31st March 20XX , Calculate and compare the following ratios
questions.solution_html:
• Calculation of ratios and making comparative study
  • Name of Bank 1) CRAR = (Tier I +Tier II ) x 100 %
  • Risk Weighted Asset
  • Travancore Bank Ltd = (900+200) X 100 13.75
  • 8000
  • MSC Bank Ltd 800+150) X 100 13.57%
  • 7000
  • Name of Bank 2) Net Profit Ratio = Net Profit* x 100 %
  • Total Income**
  • *Net Profit =
  • Income)- (Interest Expended+ Operating Expenses)}
  • – Tax @ 30%
  • ** Total Income = Interest Income+ Non-interest
  • Income
  • Travancore Bank Ltd 490 x 100 19.6
  • 2500
  • MSC Bank Ltd 420 x 100 21
  • 2000
  • Name of Bank 3) Return on Equity = Profit After Tax* x 100 %
  • Shareholder’s Fund
  • *Profit after tax=
  • Income)- (Interest Expended+ Operating Expenses)}
  • – 30%(Tax)
  • Travancore Bank Ltd 490 x 100 16.33
  • 3000
  • MSC Bank Ltd 420 x 100 21
  • 2000
  • Comparative Study: 1) Profitability: Regarding Profitability MSC Bank is 21 % which is more
  • than Travancore Bank(19.6%).This shows that MSC Bank is more profitable and gives more
  • return to its shareholders (21%)than Travancore Bank Ltd.2) Efficiency: Regarding the CRAR
  • which measures banks financial strength and stability, Travancore bank has 13.75% as CRAR
  • and MSC Bank has 13.57% .Thus Travancore Bank has strong Capital Ratio than MSC Bank.

questions.question: What are the qualitative indicators used for measuring a banks performance?
questions.solution_html:
• Qualitative Indicators for evaluating bank performance are:1) Customer Service quality
  • how effectively a bank meets the expectations of its customers through products
  • communications and overall service experience.2) Technology Adoption: Adoption of
  • technology improves efficiency, security, customer experience and competitiveness. Digital
  • banking, automation, data driven decisions etc are examples. It increases transparency
  • reduces fraud, becomes cost effective.3) Management efficiency: Quality of management in
  • utilising its resources, sustained profitability, financial stability and customer trust are
  • examples of the efficiency of management.4) Compliance and Risk Management: In order to
  • maintain stability, ensure sustainability and reduce loss banks have to follow RBI Guidelines
  • Banking Regulation Act, FEMA, KYC , AML norms etc. Adherence to Laws such as Companies
  • Act, Income Tax Act, PMLA etc and follow Code of Conduct, Operational Manuals and audit
  • recommendations. (Points like Corporate Governance, Employee engagement, Cyber security
  • and any other relevant factor- ) Any 3 points with brief explanation
questions.final_answer: and any other relevant factor- ) Any 3 points with brief explanation
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: / Differentiate Consideration for Annuity and Premium for Life Policy.
questions.solution_html:
• Consideration for Annuity is a lump-sum (one-time) payment to secure a regular future
  • income. Life Insurance Premium is a periodic (recurring) payment to secure a death or
  • maturity benefit.

questions.question: Descibe the calculation of claims to be debited to revenue account. / From the following information, calculate the amount of premium to be credited to Revenue Account.
questions.solution_html:
• Claim refers to the amount payable by the insurance company to the policyholders who
  • have suffered losses on account of an insured event. In life insurance claims arise on account
  • of death of the policy holder or maturity of policy. The following points are followed in
  • calculating claims as per Schedule 4 (Benefits Paid) in the revenue account: 1) Closing
  • outstanding claim is added and opening outstanding claim is deducted from claim.2) Claim
  • on reinsurance ceded is deducted and claim on reinsurance accepted is added in Schedule 4
questions.final_answer: on reinsurance ceded is deducted and claim on reinsurance accepted is added in Schedule 4

questions.question: What are the qualitative indicators used for measuring a banks performance?
questions.solution_html:
• Qualitative Indicators for evaluating bank performance are:1) Customer Service quality
  • how effectively a bank meets the expectations of its customers through products
  • communications and overall service experience.2) Technology Adoption: Adoption of
  • technology improves efficiency, security, customer experience and competitiveness. Digital
  • banking, automation, data driven decisions etc are examples. It increases transparency
  • reduces fraud, becomes cost effective.3) Management efficiency: Quality of management in
  • utilising its resources, sustained profitability, financial stability and customer trust are
  • examples of the efficiency of management.4) Compliance and Risk Management: In order to
  • maintain stability, ensure sustainability and reduce loss banks have to follow RBI Guidelines
  • Banking Regulation Act, FEMA, KYC , AML norms etc. Adherence to Laws such as Companies
  • Act, Income Tax Act, PMLA etc and follow Code of Conduct, Operational Manuals and audit
  • recommendations. (Points like Corporate Governance, Employee engagement, Cyber security
  • and any other relevant factor- ) Any 3 points with brief explanation
questions.final_answer: and any other relevant factor- ) Any 3 points with brief explanation
